title: Cross-validate Rust provisioning against Python reference
description:
After integration (.3-.6 complete), verify Rust BRProvisioningSession produces identical outputs to Python.

## Reference
- Python: python/src/lichen/crypto/provisioning.py (BRProvisioningSession)
- Python tests: python/tests/crypto/test_provisioning.py

## Validation
1. Same EDHOC session with same seeds -> same master secret
2. Same plaintext seed -> same encrypted payload
3. Rust can decrypt Python-encrypted payloads and vice versa
4. Error cases match (invalid payloads rejected identically)

## Deliverable
Either shared test vectors in test/vectors/provisioning.json, or a cross-call test that runs both implementations.
